background_runners: Toggle persistent automatic helpers and background tool runners.
channelbox_selection_highlight: Toggle timeline highlighting for selected Channel Box attributes.
channelbox_clear_on_selection_change: Toggle clearing Channel Box attributes when the object selection changes.
camera_orbit_selection: Toggle automatic camera orbit targeting from the current selection.
hide_static_animation_curves: Toggle automatic hiding of static curves in the Graph Editor.
animation_recovery: Toggle automatic scene-scoped animation recovery snapshots.
anim_layer_weights: Toggle a timeline overlay plotting animation-layer weight curves; muted layers show dimmed and dashed.
selector_toolbar_pin: Toggle whether the Selected Object Display toolbutton stays pinned and visible on the toolbar.
